title: Introduce cost provenance store and profile adapter for automated defaults
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Adds a provenance store for cost/profile adoption and a profile-adapter that exports suggested batching/caching/quantization defaults per tenant. Backwards compatible; opt-in via feature flag.
description:
Motivation: customers frequently adopt custom quantization and batch/caching presets but we lack a reliable signal to attribute unit economics changes back to those profile changes. This PR introduces a lightweight provenance store and a profile adapter that ties observed cost/latency delta to profile adoption and automatically surfaces recommended defaults and rollbacks.

What this changes: introduces pkg/econ/provenance (in-memory + durable Redis-backed optional), a profile-adapter service that subscribes to prefill/batch telemetry and annotates profile adoption timestamps, a new CLI command `redwood costctl profile annotate` to tag profiles with cost intents, and a tiny SDK helper (python) to fetch recommended defaults for a tenant. Also: documentation, integration tests, and an observability dashboard template.

Why now: several enterprise customers requested better guardrails when enabling compact quant profiles — customers reported cost regressions on rollout. This feature helps correlate regressions to the exact profile and generate safe rollback suggestions automatically.

Checklist:
- [x] provenance store core (in-memory + redis optional)
- [x] profile-adapter service + subscription to prefill/batch telemetry
- [x] CLI: costctl profile annotate / export-suggestions
- [x] SDK: econ.get_recommended_defaults(tenant_id) (py)
- [x] unit + integration tests for provenance tagging and suggestion export
- [x] docs: ops/cost-profiles.md + example runbook
- [x] feature-flag gated; off by default for current tenants

Backwards compatibility: adapter is opt-in and read-only unless enabled. No changes to public inference API.

Operational notes: The provenance store retains profile adoption events and a rolling 7-day window of per-profile unit-econ summaries by default. The adapter emits an event `cost.proof.suggestion` when a profile consistently worsens unit-econ beyond the configured threshold (default: 5% spend per 100k tokens). The event provides suggested settings: batch target, cache TTL, quant profile id, and a risk score.

See files_changed for a short list of touched modules and tests.

1) init: add pkg/econ/provenance interface and in-memory impl
2) impl: profile-adapter service + subscription wiring to telemetry bus
3) cli: costctl profile annotate/export-suggestions
4) sdk(py): econ.get_recommended_defaults helper
5) tests: integ/prefill_provenance_test.go + unit tests for adapter logic

review_thread:
Aarav Desai (reviewer): Can you clarify the eviction policy and memory bounds for the in-memory store?
Sofia Patel (author): Eviction is LRU with a configurable soft limit (default 10k events) and a hard cap enforced by the feature flag. Docs updated with details.

Leah Chen (reviewer): Integration tests look good but I saw a flake where the adapter emits duplicate suggestion events on rapid profile ingress. Requested change.
Sofia Patel (author): Fixed in commit 7 by adding a de-duplication window keyed by profile+tenant. Added a test to cover rapid ingress case.

Marta Ruiz (reviewer): Are there any privacy/PII concerns with storing profile metadata?
Sofia Patel (author): We only store profile ids and tenant ids; no prompt or user content. Added KMS-annotated config example for teams that need encrypted metadata at rest.

Aarav Desai: +1 after addressing eviction docs
Leah Chen: Approved
Marta Ruiz: Approved (comment: monitor event volume for the first 2 weeks)

Merge readiness: all reviewers approved, CI green, integration tests passed on rerun.

merge_summary: Merged by squash on 2026-02-20 (merge method: squash). Commit message normalized to: 'Introduce cost provenance store and profile adapter; add CLI and SDK helpers; docs and tests.' Changelog entry added to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased -> Economics. Post-merge action: rollout feature flag to staging, schedule canary for 72 hours, follow runbook in docs/ops/cost-profiles.md.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated. To enable for a tenant: toggle feature flag `enable_cost_provenance` in configs/feature_flags.yaml or via tenant API. Redis backing optional but recommended for production. Default retention: 7 days; configurable. Watch metrics: econ.provenance.events, econ.provenance.suggestions, econ.provenance.dedup_rate.
testing: Unit tests added for provenance store behavior and de-dup window. Integration test simulates profile rollout and verifies suggestion emission and suggestion payload contents. Tests are marked with tag 'long' and excluded by default from quick CI; included in nightly and canary suites.
dangerous_changes: None. Adapter is opt-in and read-only until explicitly enabled; no schema migration required for inference models.
